# BBC Science Focus Magazine

> > BBC Science Focus Magazine delivers cutting-edge science news, expert guides, and in-depth features covering space exploration, human health, technology, and nature discoveries.

BBC Science Focus Magazine is a leading science publication providing accessible coverage of breakthrough research, medical innovations, space discoveries, and wellness science. The site combines news reporting, expert guides, and curated reference content for science enthusiasts and the general public.

## Key Topics

- Space exploration
- Medical research
- Health and wellness
- Aging research
- AI and technology
- Quantum mechanics
- Human anatomy
- Mental health
- Stem cell therapy
- Exoplanet discovery
- Neuroscience
- Nutrition and diet
- Physics
- Paleontology
- Psychology

## Science News & Discoveries

- [We've found a bizarre alien magma planet surprisingly close to Earth](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/magma-lava-planet): News on discovery of magma exoplanet L 98-59 d using James Webb telescope
- [Scientists want to create 'T. Rex' quakes on the Moon](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/moonquakes-lunar-exploration): News on artificial moonquakes for lunar exploration and resource prospecting
- [This terrifying new dinosaur could rewrite the origins of T. rex](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/terrifying-new-dinosaur-origins-t-rex): News on fossil discovery offering clues to T. rex evolution origins
- [One of Earth's oldest mysteries keeps getting weirder](https://www.sciencefocus.com/planet-earth/one-of-earths-oldest-mysteries-keeps-getting-weirder): Article on lightning science and atmospheric phenomena mysteries
- [Just one day in your life could soon reveal how long you'll live](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/one-day-life-reveal-lifespan-killifish): News on Stanford study predicting lifespans using killifish behavioral patterns
- [This stunning 3D map lets anyone explore real human organs down to a single cell](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/3d-google-earth-for-organs-hoa): Article on Human Organ Atlas 3D mapping technology for anatomy research
- ['Stunning' new treatment may reverse frailty after just one dose](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/stem-cell-reverse-frailty): News on stem cell therapy breakthrough potentially reversing age-related frailty

## Health & Wellness Guides

- [The Human Body](https://www.sciencefocus.com/the-human-body): Human body section covering anatomy, health science, and wellness topics
- [What to eat if you have ADHD, according to experts](https://www.sciencefocus.com/the-human-body/adhd-diets-nutrition): Expert guide on ADHD-friendly nutrition and dietary strategies
- [8 techniques all anxious people should use, according to a psychologist](https://www.sciencefocus.com/the-human-body/anxiety-treatments): Guide on psychological techniques for anxiety management and stress relief
- [Why some experts now see Botox as a powerful antidepressant](https://www.sciencefocus.com/wellbeing/some-experts-botox-powerful-antidepressant): Article exploring Botox as potential antidepressant treatment and mental health
- [Your most draining relationships (except one) are taking years off your life, study suggests](https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/hasslers-accelerated-ageing): News on study linking stressful relationships to accelerated aging
- [5 science-backed rules for turning money into long-term happiness](https://www.sciencefocus.com/science/5-science-backed-rules-for-turning-money-into-long-term-happiness): Guide on financial psychology and science-backed rules for lasting happiness

- [A life in pictures: how photography helped one teenager through a cancer journey](https://www.sciencefocus.com/advertisement-feature/a-life-in-pictures-how-photography-helped-one-teenager-through-a-cancer-journey): Feature on cancer patient's journey using photography as coping mechanism
